corpus.policy: Translations, acoustic-text perturbations, source revisions and every prefix of a related meeting remain in one split.

source_policy.offsets: Unicode scalar indices in the exact finalized source; timestamps are source ranges, never proportional word allocation
source_policy.normalization: Unicode White_Space collapse, preserving BOM and spoken Unicode

calibration.method: Reuse calibration.py; bind use case, language, authored prompt, ordered labels, route, model/revision, preprocessing and artifact identity. Frozen held-out execution requires a previously fitted calibration artifact.

tuple_policy: Measure source-quoted complete items separately from classifier labels. Unknown owner and due phrase remain null. Exact evidence and verbatim owner/due spans are necessary; date normalization is not qualified by this task.
timeline_policy: Repeated proposals are deduplicated per prefix; changes/retractions carry final status. User accepted edits and dismissed proposals are scored separately from replaceable proposals. Appended speech never rewrites an earlier cutoff.
measurement_policy: Failures and missing calls remain in denominators. Missing latency, CPU, RSS, usage, actual generated-claim judgments or foreground/background resource evidence are unavailable, not zero or passing. UI fixtures, offline replay, inference and native/real-call acceptance are distinct.

authorization.policy: Historical acquisition/spend grants are not reused. This runner replays recordings offline and exports explicit frozen requests; execution requires separately authorized configuration.

adoption_policy: Offline and connection fixtures never qualify a model. Emit reviewable candidate records per exact context; only the app-owned reviewed registry can adopt them. Ordinary capture, notes, transcription and generative questions remain independent.
metrics: Report component event macro-F1 separately from end-to-end macro-F1, which requires a complete exact source-quoted tuple for a positive event. A minimum 0.90 applies independently to both before qualification.
